text:
People Ops: quick question — new hire Alex K accepted offer but their EAD renewal is pending; current card expires 2025-05-09. Hiring manager wants a 2025-05-10 start for onboarding. Can we do limited/voluntary onboarding before EAD arrives and delay payroll/benefits until card in hand? any compliance gotchas?
Alex K: hi! yes that's the situation. filed I-765 renewal 2025-04-20, receipt #RS1234567. happy to do docs and learning sessions early, just need to understand limitations.
Maria S: tagging legal — can you confirm category/code on the I-765? auto-extension rules depend on category. Also need to double-check I-9 remote verification rules for receipt notices.
Alex K: category on the receipt shows C33 (adjustment applicant).
Maria S: thanks. I'm checking with counsel now. short answer: we can do non-paid onboarding (training, Slack/GH read-only, paperwork) but no paid work or payroll until we confirm authorized work status. For I-9 we may accept the receipt as a temporary List A document only if the previous EAD was based on an eligible category and the receipt was timely filed — counsel confirming specifics.
Josh R: from team side we can create non-prod accounts and assign onboarding tasks that aren't billable. If payroll can't start on 5/10 we should set a tentative paid start (e.g., 5/26) and update candidate. Also want to avoid blocked seat cost — any billing implications for reserved offers?
People Ops: benefits enrollment and payroll are tied to active paid employment date. If paid start is delayed, benefits coverage won't be active until payroll start unless we request an exception. Exceptions need People Ops + Benefits team approval and legal sign-off. We can pre-fill benefits forms so activation is quick once payroll starts.
Emma L: a few operational notes: 1) remote I-9: we require either an authorized representative for in-person review or use a certified agent; USCIS receipt may allow continued employment only in specific renewal categories — need counsel confirmation. 2) SSN: please upload SSN card when available; payroll can't process without SSN. 3) Badge/access: Security can issue a building badge for onboarding-only access (no production access) if legal approves.
ImmigrationBot: Document uploaded by Alex K: I-765_receipt_RS1234567.pdf
Maria S: counsel reply: for C33 (adjustment) — timely-filed I-765 typically provides automatic 180-day EAD extension only for certain categories; counsel says we should NOT rely on extension for payroll without seeing prior EAD metadata and receipt specifics. Recommendation: proceed with unpaid onboarding 2025-05-10 (training, security briefing, non-prod accounts). Paid employment should begin once we have a physical EAD card and SSN. If card doesn't arrive by 2025-05-24, People Ops to escalate with Benefits for an exception to retro-activate coverage if needed.
People Ops: action items summarized: - Alex K: upload any additional receipts, SSN when available, and confirm if you can do an authorized I-9 agent visit (we can provide agent list). - Maria S: confirm exact I-9 document list that we can accept remotely for this case and send to Security for badge rules. - Josh R: set up non-prod accounts and mark candidate calendar for tentative paid start 2025-06-01 if EAD delayed. - Emma L: draft benefits enrollment so Alex can e-sign now (activation pending).
Alex K: got it — I'll upload SSN when received and ping when card arrives. can you share the agent list for in-person I-9 verification?
Emma L: yes, posting the short checklist here: 
```
Preboarding checklist for pending-EAD hires:
- Upload I-765 receipt (done)
- Provide copy of prior EAD (if available)
- Sign benefits forms (will remain pending)
- Book authorized I-9 verification agent OR plan for in-person HR verification
- Confirm SSN upload once card arrives
- Manager to assign non-billable onboarding tasks and request non-prod access
```
People Ops: we'll follow up with counsel on the I-9 nuance and update you by EOD 2025-05-02. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 
Josh R: thanks — appreciate the clear plan, this works for the team.
Alex K: thank you all, super helpful. will keep you posted.
